package.description: Quickly OCR part of the screen and save resulting text to clipboard

en-US.description: Quickly OCR part of the screen and save resulting text to clipboard
en-US.longDescription: Capture2Text enables users to quickly OCR a portion of the screen using a keyboard shortcut. The resulting text will be saved to the clipboard by default. Supports 90+ languages including Chinese, English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Russian, and Spanish. Portable and does not require installation.
en-US.name: Capture2Text
